threshold_status: Provisional research engineering targets; no stakeholder-approved field error tolerance or sensor-accuracy validation exists.
qualification_scope: Small chronological point-forecast pilot on the selected publisher-declared tilapia tank recording; not an operational or independent-site release.
rmse_vs_persistence: Must not exceed persistence RMSE on the identical complete cohort.
seed_gate: Require complete coverage for every registered replica. Apply accuracy/improvement gates to primary seed 17 and arithmetic mean per-seed MAE/RMSE/absolute bias/skill across seeds 17/29/43. Do not cancel opposite signed biases or substitute a better test seed.
zero_baseline_mae: Learned-model improvement qualification is unavailable; report persistence and do not manufacture a skill denominator.
horizon_gate: The 1-hour horizon is mandatory. The 3-hour horizon qualifies separately and cannot substitute for a failing primary horizon.
resource_scope: Per selected configuration/horizon artifact on a declared CPU host, without GPU acceleration; record thread settings, runtime baseline memory and protocol timings. Includes required transforms; excludes HTTP/database latency. Targets are not yet measured or portable SLAs.
issue_delay_status: Provisional new-issue scheduling allowance, not measured ingestion performance. Cached forecasts retain their original issue/target times.
